info.lang.title: Languages
info.lang.text: To add a language, copy _template.json to <code>.json (for example pt-BR.json) in the languages folder, set “_language” to its name and translate the values. To correct a built-in language, copy its file from the _reference subfolder next to it: you can keep only the lines you change. Then choose the language again in the picker (bottom right).
tray.noConfig: The settings app (D4OverlayConfig.exe) was not found next to the overlay.
app.alreadyRunning: D4 Overlay is already running — look for its icon near the clock.
info.logs.title: Diagnostics
info.logs.text: If something goes wrong, the log files (crash.log, overlay.log, shared.log) help find the cause. You can attach them to your message.
ap.overlayOpacity.hint: Applies to the whole overlay (frame and text). In move mode ({0}) it is always fully opaque, so you can find it.
ev.onlyInGame: Only while Diablo IV is running
ev.onlyInGame.hint: If unchecked, the alerts also play when the game is closed (for example to give you time to launch it).
hk.hint: Click a box, then press the key or combination you want (Backspace clears it). Shortcuts are global: they work in game, but while the overlay runs the key is no longer available to other programs. For rarely used actions, prefer a combination such as Ctrl+Alt+M.
hk.conflict: ⚠ Already used by another application — choose another key.
hk.duplicate: ⚠ This shortcut is assigned to several actions.
hk.needsModifier: ⚠ This key can't be used alone: add Ctrl or Alt (for example Ctrl+Alt+M).
set.shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
set.startup: Launch the overlay when Windows starts
set.startup.hint: Only the overlay starts, not this window. If “{0}” is unchecked, it starts silently, with just its icon near the clock.
set.startup.blocked: ⚠ Windows has disabled this startup entry (Task Manager → Startup apps). Re-enable it there.
set.show.hint: Uncheck to keep only the sound alerts: nothing is drawn on screen, and events and alerts keep working as set in each event tab. A tray icon lets you bring the overlay back or quit the app.
